title: Planned Todo and Wayfinder work ignore conflicting legacy transition data

rubric.text: Current Todo membership plus ready-for-agent and a verified usable active plan authorizes implementation preparation despite foreign, automated, older, or malformed transition data; does not request event history or another approval.
Retains exclusive ownership, configured base, active plan integrity, native blocker, and PR identity checks; column authority does not waive merge grants or independent review.
Current Todo membership plus human-applied ready-for-agent authorizes routing the unassigned AFK research child through its configured Wayfinder lane without event-history proof.

Creates any authorized new child initially in unlabelled Todo and leaves role authority to humans; never adds ready-for-agent during creation or retries. The active child does not authorize work on the unlabelled child.
